patterns.reminder: AWS access key id in edited content. This repo holds no AWS credential; remove it and rotate the key.
Stripe live secret key prefix. STRIPE_SECRET lives in Firebase Secret Manager, never in a file. Remove it and rotate the key in the Stripe dashboard.
GitHub personal access token. OPS_READ_TOKEN is a GitHub repository secret, never a file. Remove it and revoke the token at github.com/settings/tokens.
Private key material. A Firebase service-account JSON carries one; it belongs in a GitHub secret or an environment variable, never in a file here. Remove it and generate a new key.
